## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`; CONTRIBUTING.md, "Sign your work")
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (the README of the package, `docs/reference/`, `docs/guides/installation.md`)
- [ ] The release notes have an entry, for a change a user notices
